`final class TextureSampling`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.bridge.render.texture` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextureSampling.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/bridge/render/texture/TextureSampling.java)

A filter, a wrap and a mipmap flag, one of the 12 shared samplings that a render bridge can cache.

## Learn more

- [Textures and samplers](/build/pipeline/#textures-and-samplers)

<a id="TextureSampling-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `List<TextureSampling>` | [values](#TextureSampling-method-values)() <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span> | Returns the 12 samplings, read-only, in the order of their index. |
| `boolean` | [isMipmapFiltered](#TextureSampling-method-isMipmapFiltered)() | If `true`, the sampling reads mipmaps with a linear filter. |
| `int` | [getIndex](#TextureSampling-method-getIndex)() | Returns the index of the sampling, from `0` to `11`, for a cache of samplers. |
| [`TextureWrap`](/reference/bridges/texturewrap/) | [getWrap](#TextureSampling-method-getWrap)() | Returns the wrap. |

| [`TextureFilter`](/reference/bridges/texturefilter/) | [getFilter](#TextureSampling-method-getFilter)() | Returns the filter. |

## Method details

<a id="TextureSampling-method-values"></a>

### values

`List<TextureSampling> values()` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

<a id="TextureSampling-method-isMipmapFiltered"></a>

### isMipmapFiltered

`boolean isMipmapFiltered()` 

If `true`, the sampling reads mipmaps with a linear filter.

<a id="TextureSampling-method-getIndex"></a>

### getIndex

`int getIndex()` 

Returns the index of the sampling, from `0` to `11`, for a cache of samplers.

<a id="TextureSampling-method-getWrap"></a>

### getWrap

`TextureWrap getWrap()` 

Returns the wrap.

<a id="TextureSampling-method-isMipmapped"></a>

### isMipmapped

`boolean isMipmapped()` 

If `true`, the texture has mip levels that the draw may use; only a `LINEAR` filter reads them (`isMipmapFiltered()`), and a `NEAREST` sampling reads level 0 alone.

<a id="TextureSampling-method-getFilter"></a>

### getFilter

`TextureFilter getFilter()` 

Returns the filter.
